philosophy: One launcher (./pfy). Inference starts first as a pluggable OpenAI-compatible local endpoint (ADR-0014). Preferred: FreeToken (ft serve :1919), then llama-swap/llama-server, Ollama adapter. Harnesses attach.

harnesses.name: FreeToken
harnesses.summary: Edge-native MoE serving (FlashML); OpenAI+Anthropic on :1919; preferred local spine
harnesses.setup: uv pip install "freetoken[accel]"; ft serve --model <hf-or-path>. Override PFY_LOCAL_RUNTIME=freetoken
harnesses.issue_stub: Detect ft on :1919; LOCAL_OPENAI_BASE_URL for OpenCode/LiteLLM

harnesses.name: llama-swap
harnesses.summary: Hot-swap + TTL in front of llama.cpp llama-server; GGUF tok/s path

harnesses.name: llama.cpp (llama-server)
harnesses.summary: llama.cpp OpenAI-compat server; GGUF without hot-swap
harnesses.issue_stub: llama-server health; do not vendor sources

harnesses.name: Ollama
harnesses.summary: Local model server; first-class adapter (T-0101), not the only runtime
harnesses.setup: install ollama; ollama serve; pull models via pfy models pull

harnesses.name: Shimmy
harnesses.summary: Tiny Rust OpenAI-compat server; optional, not the X engine
harnesses.issue_stub: Keep optional; do not prefer over FreeToken

harnesses.name: Grok Build / CLI
harnesses.summary: Primary coding agent (subscription); skills via bootstrap/grok-cli

harnesses.name: OpenCode
harnesses.summary: Local+cloud worker surface; skills SoT shared with Grok
harnesses.setup: install opencode; point skills at bootstrap/grok-cli/skills; LOCAL_OPENAI_BASE_URL

harnesses.name: Hermes Agent
harnesses.summary: Runtime adapter: exec hermes/hermes-agent; /hermes-feedback skill stays process-only

harnesses.name: Claude Code
harnesses.summary: Runtime adapter: exec claude; optional skills-external is docs-only

harnesses.name: OpenAI Codex CLI
harnesses.summary: Runtime adapter: exec codex; OpenAI Codex CLI

harnesses.name: Exo (exoharness)
harnesses.summary: Optional lab: exec exo.sh when present (not default; not Grok replacement)
harnesses.setup: curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/exoharness/exo/main/setup.sh -o setup.sh; bash setup.sh. git+Docker required. Day-to-day ./exo.sh. Pin https://github.com/exoharness/exo. Docker on PATH is not ready.

harnesses.name: Continue.dev
harnesses.summary: IDE config recipe only (not a CLI harness). Point Continue at LOCAL_OPENAI_BASE_URL.
harnesses.setup: copy bootstrap/continue/config.json; set apiBase from LOCAL_OPENAI_BASE_URL (FreeToken :1919 first, Ollama last). Recipe: bootstrap/continue/README.md. ./pfy start continue stays STUB exit 2.

harnesses.name: agent-cage lab
harnesses.summary: Optional lab via pfy stage --lab / make cage-*
harnesses.setup: Personal lab only: ./pfy stage --lab runs make cage-doctor then cage-setup then cage-up-mcp. Missing Docker is honest skip, not product-ready. ./pfy start agent-cage stays STUB exit 2. Docker on PATH is not ready. Do not sell cage.
